decisions: The planner produces a deterministic 30-day scaffold (platform, format, angle, insight, draft hook); final copy is written by the agent and gated by the audit.
Duplicate detection uses 5-word shingles at a 0.70 threshold so reformatted cross-posts are caught without flagging shared topic vocabulary.
India Hinglish is supported by language tags rather than machine translation.
Pricing sits below Ad Creative Lab because the buyer is a content creator or small team, not an ads operator.
unresolved: Owner approval for final pricing, license and publication.
No live publishing or engagement data has been attached.
evidence: Planner produces 30 pieces, 6 platforms, every insight used 5 times, zero duplicate cells.
Clean pack audits at 100/100; flawed pack audits at 0/100 with length, CTA and cross-post findings.
